cat << 'EOF' > solution.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if a number is prime
is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ $n -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ $n -eq 2 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le $n ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

# Get current date in seconds since epoch
current_date=$(date +%s)
# 7 days in seconds
seven_days=$((7 * 24 * 3600))

total_sum=0

for file in log_files/log_server_*; do
    # Extract server ID and date from filename
    filename=$(basename "$file")
    server_id=$(echo "$filename" | grep -oP 'log_server_\K[0-9]+')
    file_date=$(echo "$filename" | grep -oP '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
    
    # Check if server ID is prime
    if is_prime "$server_id"; then
        # Check if file date is within last 7 days
        file_date_epoch=$(date -d "$file_date" +%s)
        diff=$((current_date - file_date_epoch))
        if [ $diff -le $seven_days ] && [ $diff -ge 0 ]; then
            # Sum the integers in the file
            while read -r num; do
                total_sum=$((total_sum + num))
            done < "$file"
        fi
    fi
done

echo "$total_sum"
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
bash solution.sh
